# Pivot dataframe

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


specparam <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/specparam_all.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(S = condition) %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, exponent, error, offset) %>%
  distinct()
print(specparam)

# Method 1: Compute differences FIRST, then average
specparam_diff <- specparam %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, exponent, offset) %>%
  # Aggregate within each subject×roi×P×T×S combination
  group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
  summarise(
    exponent = mean(exponent, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset = mean(offset, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Pivot to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = S,
    values_from = c(exponent, offset)
  ) %>%
  # Compute WITHIN-SUBJECT differences
  mutate(
    exponent_diff = exponent_stim - exponent_prestim,
    offset_diff = offset_stim - offset_prestim
  )

# Now average the differences (not the conditions separately)
specparam_avg <- specparam_diff %>%
  group_by(subject, roi) %>%
  summarise(
    # Keep individual conditions for plotting
    exponent_prestim = mean(exponent_prestim, na.rm = TRUE),
    exponent_stim = mean(exponent_stim, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_prestim = mean(offset_prestim, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_stim = mean(offset_stim, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Mean of differences (correct for paired data!)
    exponent_diff = mean(exponent_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    offset_diff = mean(offset_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n(), # How many P×T combinations
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Verify the difference
specparam_avg %>%
  mutate(
    # This should equal exponent_diff (it does!)
    check = exponent_stim - exponent_prestim
  ) %>%
  select(subject, roi, exponent_diff, check) %>%
  head()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(rlang)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot two-condition distributions + their difference
# Assumes 'data' already has the columns you want.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff <- function(
    data,
    value, # string: numeric column name, e.g., "itpc"
    condition, # string: condition column with EXACTLY two levels
    levels, # character(2): order controls sign (level2 - level1)
    ids, # character vector: columns defining a unit (e.g., "subject")
    groups = character(0), # character vector: columns to facet by (optional)
    facet = TRUE,
    facet_ncol = 3,
    check_unique = TRUE # stop if duplicates within ids×groups×condition
    ) {
  stopifnot(length(levels) == 2)

  # Keep only what we need
  keep_cols <- unique(c(ids, groups, condition, value))
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    mutate(!!condition := factor(.data[[condition]], levels = levels))

  # Optionally enforce uniqueness
  if (isTRUE(check_unique)) {
    n_dups <- df %>%
      summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .by = c(all_of(c(ids, groups, condition)))) %>%
      filter(n > 1L) %>%
      nrow()
    if (n_dups > 0) {
      stop("Duplicates detected within ids×groups×condition. Fix upstream or set check_unique = FALSE.")
    }
  }

  # Compute within-unit difference via wide pivot (level2 - level1)
  wide <- df %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = all_of(condition), values_from = all_of(value)) %>%
    drop_na(!!levels[1], !!levels[2]) %>%
    mutate(diff_val = .data[[levels[2]]] - .data[[levels[1]]])

  # Shared x-axis from both the raw values and the differences
  vals_cond <- df[[value]]
  vals_diff <- wide$diff_val
  rng <- range(c(vals_cond, vals_diff), na.rm = TRUE)
  pad <- diff(rng) * 0.04
  xlim_shared <- c(rng[1] - pad, rng[2] + pad)
  breaks_shared <- breaks_extended(n = 7)(c(vals_cond, vals_diff))

  # Condition distributions
  p_cond <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[value]], y = .data[[condition]], fill = .data[[condition]])) +
    stat_halfeye(
      point_interval = median_qi,
      .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
      adjust = 0.7, slab_alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = xlim_shared,
      breaks = breaks_shared,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )

  # Difference distribution
  diff_lab <- paste(levels[2], "−", levels[1])
  p_diff <- ggplot(wide, aes(x = diff_val, y = diff_lab)) +
    stat_halfeye(
      point_interval = median_qi,
      .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
      adjust = 0.7, slab_alpha = 0.6, fill = "grey60"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = xlim_shared,
      breaks = breaks_shared,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(x = value, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  # Facets (if any)
  if (facet && length(groups) > 0) {
    facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(groups, collapse = " + ")))
    p_cond <- p_cond + facet_wrap(facet_formula, ncol = facet_ncol)
    p_diff <- p_diff + facet_wrap(facet_formula, ncol = facet_ncol)
  }

  p_cond / p_diff + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# exponent (one row per subject×roi×P×T×S)
specparam_exp <- specparam %>%
  group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
  summarise(exponent = mean(exponent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# offset (one row per subject×roi×P×T×S)
specparam_off <- specparam %>%
  group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
  summarise(offset = mean(offset, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_exp <- plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff(
  data = specparam_exp,
  value = "exponent",
  condition = "S",
  levels = c("prestim", "stim"), # diff = stim - prestim
  ids = c("subject"),
  groups = c("roi", "P", "T"), # facet by ROI, P, T
  facet = TRUE,
  check_unique = TRUE # will error if you missed duplicate collapsing
)
p_exp
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

#' Validate and prepare data for two-condition comparison
#'
#' @param data Input dataframe
#' @param value Name of numeric column to analyze
#' @param condition Name of condition column (must have exactly 2 levels)
#' @param levels Character vector of length 2 specifying condition order
#' @param ids Character vector of ID columns
#' @param groups Character vector of grouping columns
#' @param check_unique Logical, whether to check for duplicates
#'
#' @return Validated and prepared dataframe
validate_and_prepare_data <- function(data, value, condition, levels,
                                      ids, groups, check_unique = TRUE) {
  # Input validation
  stopifnot(
    "levels must be length 2" = length(levels) == 2,
    "value must be in data" = value %in% names(data),
    "condition must be in data" = condition %in% names(data)
  )

  # Select and prepare columns
  keep_cols <- unique(c(ids, groups, condition, value))
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    mutate(!!condition := factor(.data[[condition]], levels = levels))

  # Check for duplicates if requested
  if (isTRUE(check_unique)) {
    n_dups <- df %>%
      summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .by = c(all_of(c(ids, groups, condition)))) %>%
      filter(n > 1L) %>%
      nrow()

    if (n_dups > 0) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "Found %d duplicate combinations in ids×groups×condition.
        Aggregate data first or set check_unique = FALSE.",
        n_dups
      ))
    }
  }

  return(df)
}

#' Compute within-unit differences between conditions
#'
#' @param data Long-format dataframe
#' @param value Name of value column
#' @param condition Name of condition column
#' @param levels Character vector of length 2 (diff = levels[2] - levels[1])
#' @param ids Character vector of ID columns
#' @param groups Character vector of grouping columns
#'
#' @return Dataframe with difference values
compute_condition_difference <- function(data, value, condition, levels,
                                         ids, groups) {
  wide <- data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(condition),
      values_from = all_of(value)
    ) %>%
    drop_na(!!levels[1], !!levels[2]) %>%
    mutate(diff_val = .data[[levels[2]]] - .data[[levels[1]]])

  return(wide)
}

#' Calculate shared axis limits and breaks for aligned plots
#'
#' @param values_list List of numeric vectors to include in range
#' @param padding_factor Proportion of range to add as padding (default 0.04)
#' @param n_breaks Number of breaks for axis (default 7)
#'
#' @return List with xlim and breaks
calculate_shared_axis <- function(values_list, padding_factor = 0.04,
                                  n_breaks = 7) {
  all_vals <- unlist(values_list)
  rng <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  pad <- diff(rng) * padding_factor

  list(
    xlim = c(rng[1] - pad, rng[2] + pad),
    breaks = breaks_extended(n = n_breaks)(all_vals)
  )
}

#' Create half-eye distribution plot
#'
#' @param data Dataframe to plot
#' @param x Name of x variable
#' @param y Name of y variable
#' @param fill Name of fill variable (optional)
#' @param axis_config List with xlim and breaks
#' @param show_x_axis Logical, whether to show x-axis elements
#' @param add_vline Logical, whether to add vertical reference line at 0
#' @param fill_color Color for fill (used if fill variable not specified)
#'
#' @return ggplot object
create_halfeye_plot <- function(data, x, y, fill = NULL,
                                axis_config, show_x_axis = TRUE,
                                add_vline = FALSE, fill_color = NULL) {
  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]]))

  # Add fill aesthetic if specified
  if (!is.null(fill)) {
    p <- p + aes(fill = .data[[fill]])
  }

  # Add half-eye geometry
  p <- p +
    stat_halfeye(
      point_interval = median_qi,
      .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
      adjust = 0.7,
      slab_alpha = 0.6,
      fill = if (is.null(fill)) fill_color else waiver()
    )

  # Add vertical line if requested
  if (add_vline) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  }

  # Configure x-axis
  p <- p +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = axis_config$xlim,
      breaks = axis_config$breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    )

  # Style x-axis display
  if (!show_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }

  # Apply theme
  p <- p +
    labs(x = if (show_x_axis) x else NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  return(p)
}

# ============================================================
# MAIN PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ============================================================

#' Plot two-condition distributions and their difference
#'
#' *Creates aligned raincloud plots comparing two conditions with a difference plot*
#'
#' @param data Dataframe in long format
#' @param value String: name of numeric column to plot
#' @param condition String: name of condition column (must have exactly 2 levels)
#' @param levels Character(2): condition levels, order determines difference direction
#' @param ids Character vector: columns that uniquely identify observations
#' @param groups Character vector: columns to facet by (optional)
#' @param facet Logical: whether to create faceted plots
#' @param facet_ncol Integer: number of columns for facets
#' @param check_unique Logical: whether to check for duplicate observations
#' @param height_ratio Numeric(2): relative heights of condition vs difference plots
#' @param padding_factor Numeric: proportion of range to add as axis padding
#'
#' @return Patchwork object with stacked plots
#'
#' @examples
#' # Basic usage
#' plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff(
#'   data = my_data,
#'   value = "response_time",
#'   condition = "task",
#'   levels = c("easy", "hard"),
#'   ids = "subject"
#' )
#'
#' # With faceting
#' plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff(
#'   data = my_data,
#'   value = "amplitude",
#'   condition = "stimulation",
#'   levels = c("sham", "active"),
#'   ids = c("subject", "trial"),
#'   groups = c("roi", "frequency_band"),
#'   facet = TRUE
#' )
plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff <- function(
    data,
    value,
    condition,
    levels,
    ids,
    groups = character(0),
    facet = TRUE,
    facet_ncol = 3,
    check_unique = TRUE,
    height_ratio = c(2, 1),
    padding_factor = 0.04) {
  # Step 1: Validate and prepare data
  df <- validate_and_prepare_data(
    data, value, condition, levels, ids, groups, check_unique
  )

  # Step 2: Compute differences
  wide <- compute_condition_difference(
    df, value, condition, levels, ids, groups
  )

  # Step 3: Calculate shared axis configuration
  axis_config <- calculate_shared_axis(
    values_list = list(df[[value]], wide$diff_val),
    padding_factor = padding_factor
  )

  # Step 4: Create condition distributions plot
  p_cond <- create_halfeye_plot(
    data = df,
    x = value,
    y = condition,
    fill = condition,
    axis_config = axis_config,
    show_x_axis = FALSE,
    add_vline = FALSE
  )

  # Step 5: Create difference distribution plot
  diff_label <- paste(levels[2], "−", levels[1])
  p_diff <- create_halfeye_plot(
    data = wide,
    x = "diff_val",
    y = diff_label,
    fill = NULL,
    axis_config = axis_config,
    show_x_axis = TRUE,
    add_vline = TRUE,
    fill_color = "grey60"
  ) + labs(x = value)

  # Step 6: Add faceting if requested
  if (facet && length(groups) > 0) {
    facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(groups, collapse = " + ")))
    p_cond <- p_cond + facet_wrap(facet_formula, ncol = facet_ncol)
    p_diff <- p_diff + facet_wrap(facet_formula, ncol = facet_ncol)
  }

  # Step 7: Combine plots
  combined <- p_cond / p_diff + plot_layout(heights = height_ratio)

  return(combined)
}

# ============================================================
# CONVENIENCE WRAPPER FOR SPECPARAM DATA
# ============================================================

#' Plot spectral parameter comparison across conditions
#'
#' *Specialized wrapper for comparing spectral parameters (exponent, offset)*
#'
#' @param data Specparam dataframe
#' @param parameter String: "exponent" or "offset"
#' @param prestim_label String: label for pre-stimulus condition
#' @param stim_label String: label for stimulus condition
#' @param group_vars Character vector: variables to group/facet by
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff
#'
#' @return Patchwork plot object
plot_specparam_comparison <- function(
    data,
    parameter = c("exponent", "offset"),
    prestim_label = "prestim",
    stim_label = "stim",
    group_vars = c("roi", "P", "T"),
    ...) {
  parameter <- match.arg(parameter)

  # Prepare data: average within subject × group_vars × condition
  data_agg <- data %>%
    group_by(subject, S, !!!syms(group_vars)) %>%
    summarise(
      value = mean(.data[[parameter]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Create plot
  plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff(
    data = data_agg,
    value = "value",
    condition = "S",
    levels = c(prestim_label, stim_label),
    ids = "subject",
    groups = group_vars,
    ...
  )
}
```

```{r}
p_exp <- plot_specparam_comparison(
  data = specparam,
  parameter = "exponent",
  group_vars = c("roi", "P", "T"),
  facet = TRUE,
  facet_ncol = 3
)
p_exp

# Example 2: Offset comparison with custom styling
p_off <- plot_specparam_comparison(
  data = specparam,
  parameter = "offset",
  group_vars = c("roi"),
  height_ratio = c(3, 1), # Make condition plot taller
  padding_factor = 0.06 # More padding
)
p_off

# Example 3: Direct use of main function with custom data
p_custom <- plot_two_condition_dist_and_diff(
  data = my_eeg_data,
  value = "amplitude",
  condition = "stimulation_type",
  levels = c("sham", "real"),
  ids = c("subject", "trial"),
  groups = c("electrode", "frequency_band"),
  facet = TRUE,
  check_unique = FALSE # If you have already aggregated
)
```
